## Goal
- Complete IVX end-to-end production certification: deploy Instagram-style instant loading (0% spinners) to GitHub + Render + APK + S3/CloudFront, verify all surfaces live with proof, and maintain full owner control.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Canonical GitHub repository `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` is the sole source of truth.
- Do not deploy a divergent local checkout directly.
- Never expose credentials, OTPs, passwords, bearer tokens, service-role keys, or personal identities.
- Do not reset, delete, overwrite, force-push, merge, or alter history without recovery preservation.
- Do not merge while required CI is failed, skipped, cancelled, or running.
- Do not mark complete until `GitHub HEAD SHA = Render deployed SHA = live /version SHA` and CI is green.
- Use the production backend's own owner-gated endpoints for authenticated operations.
- `main` branch is protected — requires PR for changes (temporarily relaxed for owner push, then restored).
- Only report items that still require engineering work; do not repeat completed audits.
- Owner directive: no transactions will be accepted until real bank deposit is confirmed.
- Owner directive: implement Instagram-style instant loading — 0% loading spinners in any module, app, or landing page.
- Do not replace or change any code from autonomous senior developer or IVX IA chat — deploy as-is.
- Owner directive: use existing landing deploy module in the app for deployment, do end-to-end QA, and fix deployment issues.
- Owner is frustrated with repeated credential issues — wants the landing deployed the same way it was before (Jul 25), not asked for new credentials again.

**What you need to do right now:**
